spans.text: Encounters often instruct players to Spawn figures or other game
components. When players are instructed to Spawn one or more
components, they place up to (as many as they can) that many
components on the spaces indicated by the text. Figures and Components
spawned by instructions must be placed in the order in which they are
listed by the instruction in question.
If you are instructed to "Spawn a Cave Sickles and a Water Loa."
You would Spawn the Cave Sickle first.
When a Combatant Spawns, players place the Combatant’s figure on the
table as indicated by the text or Diagram.
If a player Spawns a Combatant via a Totem or otherwise, and if the
Combatant’s Initiative Card is not in the Initiative Track already, place the
Combatant's Initiative Card directly after the Initiative Card of the figure
who's currently taking their turn. If the current turn is ambiguous, place
the Initiative Card at the back of the Initiative Track instead. The figure will
take it's turn the next time its Initiative Card would normally dictate that

narrative. These are usually Hidden Cards and depict boss monsters,
Espers, or characters that are friendly or opposing the players. In anycase,
these Combatant Cards always have unique names and at least one
matching Initiative Card. These Combatant Cards are represented by
unique miniatures or unique standees. Meaning, unless they require it,
players will never need to keep track of their components using Colored
These Story Combatants do not function any differently than any other
Combatant being Spawned. When instructed to Spawn one of these
Combatants, use all the rules listed above.
